name: Different Religions
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that salvation is found exclusively through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the Word made flesh and the only way to the Father, as Jesus Himself declares. Belief and baptism are essential for salvation, while rejection of this truth results in condemnation. The Bible warns believers to avoid those who promote teachings contrary to the gospel once delivered, emphasizing the seriousness of adhering to sound doctrine and rejecting false gospels.
